_policy: HAND-WRITTEN. No upstream response. All identities fictional; see README.md.
_exercises: FR-002 / Edge Cases: two members with identical or near-identical names MUST NOT be merged; distinctness is decided on attributes beyond the name.

pairs.expected: TWO member identities. A matcher that merges on name equality fails here, and so does one that merges on a high similarity score.

TWO member identities, distinguishable ONLY by constituency. This is the harder case: it is simultaneously the ambiguous-resolution fixture, because a question record carrying only the name cannot break the tie -- so the right outcome is two members AND an ambiguous question.

_not_this_case: A member whose party or House changes mid-window is the OPPOSITE case and MUST keep ONE member_id with the change in `terms` (data-model.md -> Member). Distinctness is decided on attributes beyond the name; a changed attribute on one person is not a second person.
